_comment: Tuning for the CLASSIC drillr carousel. Everything the template needs that
is not per-post lives here, so a look change is a config edit rather than a
This is a separate generator from drillr-social, not a mode of it. The two
templates share nothing but the font file and the queue machinery.
width/height are the OUTER frame. The off-white band inside it is sized by
render.py from the reference aspect - do not try to set it here.
_script: The seven slides, in order, and where each one gets its picture.
copy: the key on the post that carries this slide's headline. `features`
is indexed, so features.0 is the first feature headline.
image: a file in assets/, or `pool:<folder>` to take the next image from
backgrounds/<folder>. `aside` is the second picture on slide 6.
brief: what the copy model is told this slide has to say. Edit these and
the drafting prompt changes with them - nothing restates the script.
The four screens/*.jpg are fixed app captures. Re-shoot them and drop the
new files in with the same names; nothing else needs to change.

script.brief: The cover. Frames the carousel as a short list of apps worth having, the way the reference set does. It must not name a feature.
Fixed - the numbered name card. Leave it as 1.Drillr.
The daily session: Drillr builds the plan and picks the work for the position you actually play.
The position screen: your four physical attributes scored, and the pro tips that go with your position.
The diet tab: calories and macros for the day, and what to eat around a session.
The progress tab: the work you have put in, month by month, so the change is visible.
Fixed - the close. Two lines over the photo, Link in bio under it.

_comment: Slides the model never writes. `appTitle` keeps the 1. because the
reference set is framed as a countdown - drop the number and the hook
landscape carries the hook and the CTA photo - both sit in a wide slot,
so a 9:16 wallpaper lands there badly. portrait carries the player shot
beside the progress screenshot. Kept apart rather than cropped from one
pool because the template shows each photo at its own aspect.
OFF until the app clears TikTok's audit - same blocker as drillr-social,
and the same account, so clearing it once clears it for both.
urlPrefix must be a domain verified in the TikTok developer portal.
privacyLevel stays SELF_ONLY while unaudited: TikTok forces private on
unaudited clients anyway, and asking for PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE just fails.
